verdict_reason: The rewritten AC15 style test is correct in intent but its search-icon and behind-the-input assertions would still pass with no icon image or the wrong stacking, so the new behaviour is only weakly tested.

todos.issue: AC15 test 'paints the search icon behind the interactive input' does not prove an icon is painted or that it is behind the input: searchIconPainted only checks the wrapper ::after content is not 'none' (passes with the background image removed), and inputIsTopHit cannot fail because elementsFromPoint never returns a pseudo-element and the ::after is pointer-events:none, so it passes whatever the ::after z-index is. The old test proved the stacking with the real arrow element in the hit stack; that proof was lost in the rewrite.
todos.fix: Assert the ::after computed styles that carry the behaviour: backgroundImage contains 'data:image/svg+xml' (the magnifying glass), zIndex is '-1' and pointerEvents is 'none', alongside the existing arrowHidden/wrapperZIndex checks; rename or drop inputIsTopHit if it is kept only as a click-through check.
